v-jp-0f6f6338.playTimes: Individual badminton on the 3 courts in 2- or 3-hour slots on days in the monthly schedule; book a court in person on the day, first come first served. Group slots not booked 7 days ahead become individual slots.
v-jp-0f6f6338.note: Adult ¥300 per 3-hour slot or ¥200 per 2-hour slot. Hall has 3 badminton courts; group hire of the hall ¥4,800 per 3-hour slot (¥3,200 for 16:00-18:00).
v-jp-0f6f6338.name: 桜台体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：月間予定の日にコート3面、2時間または3時間単位。当日に窓口でコートを予約、先着順です。7日前までに予約のない団体枠は個人枠になります。

v-jp-1e6edae0.playTimes: Individual badminton on set days in 2-hour turns from 9:30 AM (often daytime in part of the main arena); check the monthly event and open-use schedule. Groups can book arena sections in 2.5-hour slots.
v-jp-1e6edae0.note: Esforta Arena Hachioji. 300 yen per 2-hour turn (adults), rackets lent free, no coach. Smallest booking: 1/3 main arena 6,000 yen for 9:30 AM–12 PM. Fees rise from April 2027. [perCourtHour 2400 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-1e6edae0.name: 総合体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：決まった日に9:30から2時間交代（日中にメインアリーナの一部で行うことが多い）。月間の行事・個人開放予定を確認してください。団体はアリーナを区画ごとに2.5時間単位で予約できます。

v-jp-367e5598.playTimes: Badminton is one of the sports in individual sessions in the main and sub arenas; days and times change monthly, so check the monthly individual-use notice. Groups can book the halls through the facility reservation system.
v-jp-367e5598.note: Adult ¥400 per individual entry (half price with Musashino resident card); session length set in the monthly notice. Closed on the 15th of each month. Long closure for renovation planned for about 16 months during FY2027-2028.
v-jp-367e5598.name: 武蔵野総合体育館・武蔵野陸上競技場

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントンはメインアリーナ・サブアリーナでの個人利用の種目の一つです。曜日と時間は毎月変わるため、月ごとの個人利用案内を確認してください。団体は施設予約システムでアリーナを予約できます。

v-jp-403aa5cf.playTimes: Individual badminton (no booking) on the 2nd Saturday, 3rd Sunday and 4th Saturday 9 AM–1 PM, in 2-hour turns; check the ward's yearly schedule for changes. Groups can book courts through the ward's Sazanka-net reservation system.
v-jp-403aa5cf.note: Individual fee 200 yen per 2-hour turn (adults); free for registered ward children. Hall has 4 badminton courts; group booking 1/4 of the hall (1 court) is 1,500 yen for 2 hours. Group booking needs prior registration.
v-jp-403aa5cf.name: 高円寺体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用（予約不要）：第2土曜・第3日曜・第4土曜 9:00〜13:00、2時間交代。変更は区の年間予定で確認してください。団体は区の施設予約システム「さざんかねっと」でコートを予約できます。

v-jp-440f785c.playTimes: Individual badminton and table tennis every Tuesday and Friday 9 AM–5 PM, walk-in, no registration. Registered groups can book the hall by the hour 9 AM–9 PM outside those times.
v-jp-440f785c.note: Former Tachibana elementary school gym. 170 yen per 2 hours (max 4 hours). Group rate is for the whole hall: 410 yen per hour for ward groups, 580 yen evenings; 610/870 yen for outside groups. [perCourtHour 410 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-440f785c.name: 立花体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン・卓球の個人利用：毎週火・金 9:00〜17:00、予約・登録不要。登録団体はそれ以外の時間に、9:00〜21:00の間で体育室を1時間単位で予約できます。

v-jp-44a830aa.playTimes: Individual badminton in the main hall on 1st and 5th Sundays afternoon and evening, 3rd Sunday evening, Monday evening and Wednesday afternoon; check the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the ward reservation system.
v-jp-44a830aa.note: Individual ticket ¥450 per session (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 or evening 18:00-21:30). Group hire by session, half hall at half price; no per-court fee.
v-jp-44a830aa.name: 深川北スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 大体育室でバドミントン個人利用：第1・第5日曜の午後と夜間、第3日曜の夜間、月曜の夜間、水曜の午後。月間予定を確認してください。団体は区の予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-45b4864d.playTimes: Walk-in individual use at the counter 9 AM–9:30 PM when no group has booked; sports are set by day, so check the monthly individual-use schedule. Groups can book a single badminton court (1/8 of the main hall) in 2-hour slots.
v-jp-45b4864d.note: Fees from April 2026. Individual 120 yen per hour for Akiruno residents/workers (180 yen others; bring ID). Court: 1/8 of main hall = 1 badminton court, 300 yen per 2 hours for city groups (900 yen others). Closed 1st/3rd/5th Tuesdays.
v-jp-45b4864d.name: 秋川体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: 団体予約がない時間は、9:00〜21:30に窓口で受付して個人利用できます。種目は曜日ごとに決まっているため、月間の個人利用予定を確認してください。団体はバドミントンコート1面（大体育室の8分の1）を2時間単位で予約できます。

v-jp-48c07699.playTimes: Groups can book the hall in 4-hour slots (9 AM–1 PM, 1–5 PM, 5–9 PM) through Setagaya's Keyaki-net system, except when the facility runs its own events. No individual sessions are listed.
v-jp-48c07699.note: Former Ikejiri elementary school gym (667 m2), now part of HOME/WORK VILLAGE. Whole hall 1,640 yen per 4-hour slot (from Oct 2025). Badminton is a listed use. Registration needed. [perCourtHour 410 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-48c07699.name: 池尻2丁目体育館（複合施設）

playTimesLocal.ja: 団体は世田谷区の「けやきネット」で体育室を4時間単位（9:00〜13:00、13:00〜17:00、17:00〜21:00）で予約できます。施設の主催事業の日を除きます。個人利用の案内はありません。

v-jp-50204bac.playTimes: Individual badminton on Tuesdays 2-5 PM (not on holidays). Groups can book the hall through the Toshima reservation system.
v-jp-50204bac.note: Adult ¥300 per session (3 h). Group hire of the hall ¥8,800 morning (3 h), ¥11,600 afternoon or evening.
v-jp-50204bac.name: 雑司が谷体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：火曜 14:00〜17:00（祝日を除く）。団体は豊島区の施設予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-56feb4b1.playTimes: Individual badminton on Fridays 4:30–9:30 PM in the first hall, except holidays and event days. Groups can book half or all of the hall in 2.5-hour slots.
v-jp-56feb4b1.note: Kokubunji civic sports centre (first hall has 7 badminton courts). 300 yen per session (adults). Half hall 3,000 yen per 2.5-hour slot (Kokubunji resident rate). Rackets lent. [perCourtHour 1200 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-56feb4b1.name: 市民スポーツセンター・けやき運動場

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：金曜 16:30〜21:30、第1体育室（祝日・行事の日を除く）。団体は体育室の半面または全面を2.5時間単位で予約できます。

v-jp-5ca25129.playTimes: Individual badminton in the main and sub arenas on Sundays and on Tuesdays of the 2nd, 4th and 5th weeks, in 2-hour sessions from 9 AM to 9 PM, when not booked by groups. Groups can book through the Katsushika reservation system.
v-jp-5ca25129.note: Adult ¥400 per 2 hours. Group hire per 2-hour session: main arena full ¥10,200-15,500, half ¥5,100-7,750; sub arena ¥5,000-7,200.
v-jp-5ca25129.name: 水元総合スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：日曜と第2・第4・第5週の火曜、メインアリーナ・サブアリーナで9:00〜21:00の2時間単位（団体予約がない場合）。団体は葛飾区の施設予約システムで予約できます。

v-jp-5eac4528.playTimes: The first hall (4 badminton courts) is closed for ceiling work, expected until about the end of January 2027, so individual badminton is suspended. Before the closure it ran on the 2nd and 4th Saturdays 1–5 PM.
v-jp-5eac4528.note: Closed since 12 Sep 2025 (ceiling not quake-safe); reopening date not set. Individual 300 yen per session. Half hall 1,600 yen per 2.5-hour slot for city groups (double for others). [perCourtHour 640 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-5eac4528.name: ひかりスポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 第1体育室（バドミントン4面）は天井工事のため2027年1月末ごろまで休止予定で、バドミントンの個人利用も休止中です。休止前は第2・第4土曜 13:00〜17:00に行っていました。

v-jp-5eea9626.playTimes: Individual badminton (no booking) on the 2nd Saturday 9 AM–1 PM and the 1st and 3rd Wednesdays 5–9 PM, in 2-hour turns; check the ward's yearly schedule for changes. Groups can book courts through the ward's Sazanka-net reservation system.
v-jp-5eea9626.note: Individual fee 200 yen per 2-hour turn (adults); free for registered ward children. Hall has 4 badminton courts; group booking 1/4 of the hall (1 court) is 1,500 yen for 2 hours. Group booking needs prior registration.
v-jp-5eea9626.name: 妙正寺体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用（予約不要）：第2土曜 9:00〜13:00、第1・第3水曜 17:00〜21:00、2時間交代。変更は区の年間予定で確認してください。団体は区の施設予約システム「さざんかねっと」でコートを予約できます。

v-jp-5f18c995.playTimes: Individual badminton (no booking) on the 1st Sunday 1–5 PM, 2nd Saturday 5–9 PM and 1st Wednesday 5–9 PM, in 2-hour turns; check the ward's yearly schedule for changes. Groups can book courts through the ward's Sazanka-net reservation system.
v-jp-5f18c995.note: Individual fee 200 yen per 2-hour turn (adults); free for registered ward children. Hall has 4 badminton courts; group booking 1/4 of the hall (1 court) is 1,500 yen for 2 hours. Group booking needs prior registration.
v-jp-5f18c995.name: 荻窪体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用（予約不要）：第1日曜 13:00〜17:00、第2土曜 17:00〜21:00、第1水曜 17:00〜21:00、2時間交代。変更は区の年間予定で確認してください。団体は区の施設予約システム「さざんかねっと」でコートを予約できます。

v-jp-65ede849.playTimes: Individual badminton is in 1-hour slots on days set in the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the Nerima public reservation system.
v-jp-65ede849.note: Badminton individual use ¥100 per 1 hour (¥50 for 65-74). 6 badminton courts. Group hire: full hall ¥9,300, half ¥4,800 per 3-hour slot.
v-jp-65ede849.name: 平和台体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：月間予定で決まった日に1時間単位。団体は練馬区の公共施設予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-6a511304.playTimes: Individual badminton in the main hall on Mondays 9 AM-12 PM, 2nd and 4th Sundays 1-5 PM and 6-9:30 PM, 2nd Saturdays, and Thursday evenings 6-9:30 PM (half hall) when no class runs; check the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the ward reservation system.
v-jp-6a511304.note: Individual ticket ¥450 per session (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 or evening 18:00-21:30); ¥100 for residents 65+. Group hire of the main hall is by session, e.g. weekday morning (3 h) ¥16,250 for the whole hall (6 badminton courts), half hall at half price; no per-court fee.
v-jp-6a511304.name: 亀戸スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 大体育室でバドミントン個人利用：月曜 9:00〜12:00、第2・第4日曜 13:00〜17:00と18:00〜21:30、第2土曜、教室がない木曜の夜間 18:00〜21:30（半面）。月間予定を確認してください。団体は区の予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-6aaaf0cd.playTimes: Individual badminton (no booking) on the 1st Sunday 5–9 PM, 2nd Saturday and 3rd Sunday 9 AM–1 PM, and 3rd Wednesday 5–9 PM, in 2-hour turns; check the ward's yearly schedule for changes. Groups can book courts through the ward's Sazanka-net reservation system.
v-jp-6aaaf0cd.note: Individual fee 200 yen per 2-hour turn (adults); free for registered ward children. Hall has 4 badminton courts; group booking 1/4 of the hall (1 court) is 1,500 yen for 2 hours. Group booking needs prior registration.
v-jp-6aaaf0cd.name: 永福体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用（予約不要）：第1日曜 17:00〜21:00、第2土曜・第3日曜 9:00〜13:00、第3水曜 17:00〜21:00、2時間交代。変更は区の年間予定で確認してください。団体は区の施設予約システム「さざんかねっと」でコートを予約できます。

v-jp-701677ec.note: Indoor heated pool only. Badminton is in the sports hall of the same park (Okura sports ground, separate entry).
v-jp-701677ec.name: 大蔵運動場温水プール（総合運動場温水プール）

v-jp-7f042c0a.playTimes: Open badminton on Wednesdays 3–9:30 PM in the first hall, with a beginner coach and free racket and shuttle loan. Groups can book the hall in about 3-hour slots.
v-jp-7f042c0a.note: 300 yen per visit (adults). First hall has 6 badminton courts; half hall 1,800 yen for 9–11:50 AM (2,100 yen evening). Fees rise from April 2027. [perCourtHour 635 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-7f042c0a.name: 甲の原体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン開放：水曜 15:00〜21:30、第1体育室。初心者向けの指導員がいて、ラケットとシャトルを無料で貸し出しています。団体は体育室を約3時間単位で予約できます。

v-jp-927f294e.playTimes: Registered groups can book the 3rd-floor hall (3 badminton courts) in slots between 9 AM and 9 PM through Keyaki-net. The free individual hour (3–4 PM) is for basketball shooting; ask staff about other sports.
v-jp-927f294e.note: Whole floor only: 7,640 yen for 9 AM–12 PM on weekdays/Saturdays (9,170 yen Sun/holidays); evening 9,900 yen. Individual use in principle for ward residents, workers and students. [perCourtHour 2547 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-927f294e.name: 希望丘地域体育館（複合施設）

playTimesLocal.ja: 登録団体は「けやきネット」で3階体育室（バドミントン3面）を9:00〜21:00の枠で予約できます。無料の個人利用（15:00〜16:00）はバスケットボールのシュート練習用です。ほかの種目はスタッフに確認してください。

v-jp-9913661d.playTimes: Individual badminton in the main hall on Sundays (1st, 3rd and 5th) in the afternoon and evening, Monday afternoon, and Tuesday and Thursday evenings; check the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the ward reservation system.
v-jp-9913661d.note: Individual ticket ¥450 per session (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 or evening 18:00-21:30). Main hall has 6 badminton courts; group hire by session, half hall at half price; no per-court fee.
v-jp-9913661d.name: 東砂スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 大体育室でバドミントン個人利用：第1・第3・第5日曜の午後と夜間、月曜の午後、火・木の夜間。月間予定を確認してください。団体は区の予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-9cb00241.note: Not a badminton venue: children's animal area / pony school in Mizumoto Sports Center Park.
v-jp-9cb00241.name: 水元スポーツセンター公園子ども動物広場（ポニースクールかつしか）

v-jp-9cdda826.note: Athletics stadium with artificial-turf infield; indoor space is only a 115 m2 multipurpose room for dance and light exercise. No sports hall.
v-jp-9cdda826.name: フクシ・エンタープライズ墨田フィールド（墨田区総合運動場）

v-jp-9d3e13b1.playTimes: Coached badminton sessions (shido kokai) in the evening slot 6:30–9:30 PM on set days, for example some Tuesdays in the main arena and Saturdays in the second arena; check the weekly schedule on the centre's site. Groups can also book arenas through the reservation system.
v-jp-9d3e13b1.note: Individual fee 300 yen per 3-hour slot (adults). Smallest booking: half main arena 7,100 yen for 8–11 AM weekdays (larger in later slots). Bring rackets and shuttles (no rental). Parts closed for renovation and school use in FY2026. [perCourtHour 2367 dropped: the unit is more than one court]
v-jp-9d3e13b1.name: 総合スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 指導付きのバドミントン（指導公開）：決まった日の夜間 18:30〜21:30。例として一部の火曜はメインアリーナ、土曜は第2アリーナ。週間予定はセンターのサイトで確認してください。団体は予約システムでアリーナも予約できます。

v-jp-9f05269a.playTimes: Individual badminton on Fridays 1:15-3:15 PM, 3:30-5:30 PM (from age 7, children have priority courts), 5:40-7:25 PM and 7:35-9:20 PM; none on holidays. Groups can book the hall through the Toshima reservation system.
v-jp-9f05269a.note: These shorter sessions are half price: adult ¥200 (normal ¥400). Friday badminton rules changed from 17 Jul 2026. Group hire of the hall ¥8,800 morning, ¥11,600 afternoon or evening.
v-jp-9f05269a.name: 豊島体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：金曜 13:15〜15:15、15:30〜17:30（7歳以上、子ども優先コートあり）、17:40〜19:25、19:35〜21:20。祝日は行いません。団体は豊島区の施設予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-a1aec277.playTimes: Individual badminton on Mondays and Wednesdays, and on Fridays, Sundays and holidays when no group has booked; on the day, put your name down from 8:30 AM in person. Groups can book through the Nerima public reservation system.
v-jp-a1aec277.note: Individual fee ¥100-300 per slot (1-3 h). Group hire: full hall ¥13,200, half ¥6,600 per 3-hour slot. Main hall was closed for renovation Apr-Sep 2026.
v-jp-a1aec277.name: 総合体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：月・水、団体予約がない金・日・祝日。当日8:30から窓口で名前を記入します。団体は練馬区の公共施設予約システムで予約できます。

v-jp-a2568f6e.playTimes: Individual badminton in the main hall on 2nd and 4th Sundays afternoon and evening, Monday afternoon and evening, Tuesday morning and Friday evening; check the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the ward reservation system.
v-jp-a2568f6e.note: Individual ticket ¥450 per session (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 or evening 18:00-21:30). Group hire by session, half hall at half price; no per-court fee.
v-jp-a2568f6e.name: 深川スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: 大体育室でバドミントン個人利用：第2・第4日曜の午後と夜間、月曜の午後と夜間、火曜の午前、金曜の夜間。月間予定を確認してください。団体は区の予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-a3d60570.note: Not a badminton venue: a disaster-supply storage container at the city gym site.
v-jp-a3d60570.name: 市民体育館備蓄コンテナ

v-jp-a3e3f33e.playTimes: Individual badminton (half of the main hall) on 1st Sundays morning and afternoon, Monday, Tuesday (1st and 3rd weeks) and Thursday sessions, and 2nd Saturdays; check the monthly schedule. Groups can book the hall through the ward reservation system.
v-jp-a3e3f33e.note: Individual ticket ¥450 per session (morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-17:00 or evening 18:00-21:30); ¥100 for residents 65+. Group hire of the main hall is by session, e.g. weekday morning (3 h) ¥21,300 for the whole hall (8 badminton courts), half hall at half price; no per-court fee.
v-jp-a3e3f33e.name: 有明スポーツセンター

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用（大体育室の半面）：第1日曜の午前と午後、月曜・火曜（第1・第3週）・木曜の各回、第2土曜。月間予定を確認してください。団体は区の予約システムで体育室を予約できます。

v-jp-a478ada8.note: Disaster supply warehouse inside the Chuo sports centre, not a playing venue. Badminton is at the sports centre entry itself.
v-jp-a478ada8.name: 総合スポーツセンター防災備蓄倉庫

v-jp-a58b76f1.playTimes: Individual badminton on one court in the main hall Monday to Saturday, in slots between 9 AM and 9 PM, first come first served; the plan is fixed three days ahead and can change with events. Registered groups book through the city's reservation system.
sources: https://koganei-sports.jp/wp/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/【HP掲載用】総合体育館個人利用スケジュール-1.pdf
v-jp-a58b76f1.note: In Koganei Park. 400 yen per 2 hours (200 yen per hour). Main hall fits 8 badminton courts. No equipment rental. Group fees not found on the official pages.
v-jp-a58b76f1.name: 総合体育館

playTimesLocal.ja: バドミントン個人利用：月〜土、大体育室のコート1面で9:00〜21:00の枠、先着順。予定は3日前に確定し、行事で変わることがあります。登録団体は市の予約システムで予約します。

v-jp-a69c7705.playTimes: Individual badminton on Tuesday mornings 9 AM-12 PM and Saturday evenings 5:30-9 PM, plus 2nd and 4th Saturday afternoons 1-5:15 PM; none on holidays. Groups can book the hall, which has 4 badminton courts, through the Toshima reservation system.
